description:
We are Team SARIS, six undergraduate students from Brazil and Pakistan: Erik, Patrick, Luiz, Renan, Bilal and Bisman. 

As a team, we bring skills in:

Software Development: Python, JavaScript and web technologies to build working tools.

Data Processing & Analysis: handling large datasets and finding meaningful patterns in them.

Visualization & UI/UX: turning raw radar imagery into an analysis visualization.

Our goal is to make SAR data accessible and engaging.
